zh.principle: **算法**：真随机数发生器（True Random Number Generator）。§2.1 说明模型与其组成：「This section describes the entropy source model in detail.Figure 1 illustrates the model that this Recommendation uses to describe an entropy source and its components, which consist of a noise source, an optional conditioning component and a health testi」，即真随机性的来源是被采样的噪声过程。§2.2 给出数字化的位置：「If the non-deterministic activity being sampled produces something other than binary data, the sampling process includes a digitization process that converts the output samples to bits.The output of the digitized noise source is called the raw data.」
zh.why: 必要性由根这一说法给出：「The noise source is the root of security for the entropy source and for the RBG as a whole.This is the component that contains the non-deterministic, entropy-providing process that is ultimately responsible for the uncertainty associated with the bitstrin」。也就是说，整个随机数体系的不确定性最终只能落到这个非确定性过程上，这正是需要真随机源的论据；纯算法展开的部件不具备这种性质。
zh.used: 部署侧的动作由本文件规定。§1.1 指明对象读者：「This Recommendation is intended for use by entropy source developers (the entity that designs and builds the entropy source or a portion thereof), submitters1 (the entity that submits the entropy」。§2.2.3 把守护手段分层：「The health tests can be separated into three categories: start-up tests, continuous tests (primarily on the noise source), and on-demand tests」，即真随机源靠启动检测、连续检测与按需检测三类健康测试来守住，其输出再交给注册机制取用；这份文件通篇把这类装置称作熵源与 NRBG，也即硬件真随机数发生器。
zh.broken: 限度与失败模式印在同一节：「If the noise source fails to generate random outputs, no other component in the RBG can compensate for the lack of entropy; hence, no security guarantees can be made for the application relying on the RBG.」即健康检测与调节都不能替代噪声本身；这也解释了为什么该文件把样本采集与数字化写成假设条件，其一同句为「This Recommendation assumes that the sample values (i.e., the symbols) obtained from a noise source consist of fixed-length bitstrings」。
zh.history: 版本事实：关键词行印为「Conditioning functions; entropy source; health testing; min-entropy; noise source; predictors; random number generators」，§1 说明对象读者：「This Recommendation is intended for use by entropy source developers (the entity that designs and builds the entropy source or a portion thereof), submitters1 (the entity that submits the entropy」。本留存件为 SP 800-90B（2018 年 12 月）；该条目所属目录行原写（该行的出处标题写作 NIST SP 800-90B，并把年份标成 2007），与留存件日期不符，该年份问题已另列目录更正待办。

en.principle: **Algorithm**: True Random Number Generator (真随机数发生器). Section 2.1 describes the model and its parts: "This section describes the entropy source model in detail. Figure 1 illustrates the model that this Recommendation uses to describe an entropy source and its components, which consist of a noise source, an optional conditioning component and a health testi" — true randomness is traced to a sampled noise process. §2.2 places digitisation: "If the non-deterministic activity being sampled produces something other than binary data, the sampling process includes a digitization process that converts the output samples to bits. The output of the digitized noise source is called the raw data."
en.why: The necessity is stated through the root-of-security claim: "The noise source is the root of security for the entropy source and for the RBG as a whole. This is the component that contains the non-deterministic, entropy-providing process that is ultimately responsible for the uncertainty associated with the bitstrin". Every uncertainty in the random-bit system ultimately rests on that non-deterministic process, which is the argument for needing a true source; a purely algorithmic expander has no such property.
en.used: What a deployment does is prescribed by this document. §1.1 names the audience: "This Recommendation is intended for use by entropy source developers (the entity that designs and builds the entropy source or a portion thereof), submitters1 (the entity that submits the entropy". §2 layers the safeguards: "The health tests can be separated into three categories: start-up tests, continuous tests (primarily on the noise source), and on-demand tests" - a true source is guarded by start-up, continuous and on-demand health tests before a registered mechanism draws from it; throughout, the document calls such a device an entropy source or an NRBG, that is, a hardware random number generator.
en.broken: The limit and the failure mode are printed in the same section: "If the noise source fails to generate random outputs, no other component in the RBG can compensate for the lack of entropy; hence, no security guarantees can be made for the application relying on the RBG." Neither health tests nor conditioning can substitute for the noise itself. Hence the document states its assumption directly: "This Recommendation assumes that the sample values (i.e., the symbols) obtained from a noise source consist of fixed-length bitstrings".
en.history: Version facts: the keyword line reads "Conditioning functions; entropy source; health testing; min-entropy; noise source; predictors; random number generators", and §1 names the audience: "This Recommendation is intended for use by entropy source developers (the entity that designs and builds the entropy source or a portion thereof), submitters1 (the entity that submits the entropy". The retained copy is SP 800-90B (December 2018). The catalog row for this entity cites the 90B document while dating it 2007, which contradicts the retained document; that date defect is carried as a separate catalog correction.

zh: 熵源：由噪声源、可选调节组件与健康测试共同构成的组件。
噪声源：熵源乃至整个随机比特发生器的安全之根。
raw data：数字化后的噪声源输出。
min-entropy：本建议采用的最坏情形不确定性度量。
health tests：分为启动检测、连续检测与按需检测三类。
conditioning component：可选的熵调节部件，其最窄内部宽度记为 nw。
en: Entropy source: the component made of a noise source, an optional conditioning component and health tests.
Noise source: the root of security for the entropy source and for the whole random bit generator.
Raw data: the output of the digitised noise source.
Min-entropy: the worst-case unpredictability measure this Recommendation uses.
Health tests: start-up tests, continuous tests and on-demand tests.
Conditioning component: the optional entropy-conditioning part, whose narrowest internal width is denoted nw.
